Fix deletion of globally enabled skills.

- “Permanently delete” is now available in the TUI for enabled library skills.
- `skmr delete <skill>` no longer requires disabling the skill first. Its confirmation preview includes removal of owned global links.
- Project placements and group references still protect skills from deletion. Dry runs and cancelled confirmations preserve the skill and its links.

## Upgrade

```sh
brew update
brew upgrade faizmokh/tap/skmr
```
